[[Category:BITwiki Schema Matter]]


= BITwiki Property Dictionary: Semantic MediaWiki Property Reference =

== Etymology: The Nature of Attribution ==

''Property'' — from Latin ''proprietas'', from ''proprius'', one's own, special, particular. That which is proper to something, that which belongs to it, that which characterizes it. A property is not an arbitrary label but a dimension of being—a way that something shows up in the world.

''Dictionary'' — from Medieval Latin ''dictionarium'', from Latin ''dictio'', speaking, saying, word. A collection of sayings, a gathering of words. This dictionary gathers the words we use to speak about entities—not to fix them but to enable conversation.

== Overview: Properties as Emergent Dimensions ==

This document defines all Semantic MediaWiki (SMW) properties used in BITwiki. Properties enable machine-queryable knowledge by typing relationships between entities. They are not fixed categories but emergent dimensions—they arise from the need to describe, to differentiate, to query.

Properties enable:
* '''Description''': Characterizing entities across dimensions
* '''Differentiation''': Distinguishing entities from one another
* '''Query''': Finding entities that share characteristics
* '''Validation''': Checking consistency and completeness

They evolve with use. New properties emerge; old properties transform; unused properties dissolve.

== Property Categories: Dimensions of Description ==

=== 1. Entity Classification Properties ===

==== Has entity type ====
* '''Type:''' Page
* '''Purpose:''' Classify entity into canonical types
* '''Values:''' Topic, Idea, Implementation, Project, Protocol, Dataset (and emergent types)
* '''Example:''' [[Has entity type::Idea]]
* '''Required:''' Yes
* '''Cardinality:''' Single (one primary type per entity)

==== Has extended type ====
* '''Type:''' Text
* '''Purpose:''' Classify extended entity types beyond core taxonomy
* '''Values:''' Person, Organization, Event, Publication, Tool (and emergent types)
* '''Example:''' [[Has extended type::Person]]
* '''Required:''' No
* '''Cardinality:''' Multiple

=== 2. Epistemic Properties ===

==== Has epistemic status ====
* '''Type:''' Text
* '''Purpose:''' Indicate knowledge validation tier
* '''Values:''' Hypothetical, Emerging, Established, Verified, Axiomatic (tiers may evolve)
* '''Example:''' [[Has epistemic status::Established]]
* '''Required:''' Yes
* '''Cardinality:''' Single (one status per claim)

==== Has confidence score ====
* '''Type:''' Number
* '''Purpose:''' Quantify certainty on continuous scale (0.0-1.0)
* '''Constraints:''' 0.0 <= value <= 1.0
* '''Example:''' [[Has confidence score::0.87]]
* '''Required:''' Yes (numeric representation)
* '''Cardinality:''' Single
* '''Note:''' Use for precise quantitative confidence assessment

==== Has confidence ====
* '''Type:''' Text
* '''Purpose:''' Qualitative certainty assessment
* '''Values:''' low, medium, high, very high (or descriptive phrases)
* '''Example:''' [[Has confidence::high]]
* '''Required:''' Yes (textual representation)
* '''Cardinality:''' Single
* '''Note:''' Use for human-readable confidence levels; maps to confidence score ranges

==== Has evidence count ====
* '''Type:''' Number
* '''Purpose:''' Count supporting sources
* '''Constraints:''' Integer, non-negative
* '''Example:''' [[Has evidence count::12]]
* '''Required:''' No
* '''Cardinality:''' Single

==== Has replication status ====
* '''Type:''' Text
* '''Purpose:''' Indicate replication state of empirical claims
* '''Values:''' Awaiting, Partial, Consistent, Extensive
* '''Example:''' [[Has replication status::Consistent]]
* '''Required:''' No
* '''Cardinality:''' Single

==== Has review type ====
* '''Type:''' Text
* '''Purpose:''' Indicate evidence synthesis type
* '''Values:''' Single study, Multiple studies, Meta-analysis, Systematic review, Textbook
* '''Example:''' [[Has review type::Meta-analysis]]
* '''Required:''' No
* '''Cardinality:''' Single

==== Has last review date ====
* '''Type:''' Date
* '''Purpose:''' Track epistemic review timing
* '''Example:''' [[Has last review date::2026-02-14]]
* '''Required:''' No
* '''Cardinality:''' Single

=== 3. Provenance Properties ===

==== Has author ====
* '''Type:''' Page
* '''Purpose:''' Attribute content to primary creator
* '''Example:''' [[Has author::Person:Norbert Wiener]]
* '''Required:''' Yes
* '''Cardinality:''' Multiple (multiple contributors allowed)

==== Has contributor ====
* '''Type:''' Page
* '''Purpose:''' Acknowledge additional contributors
* '''Example:''' [[Has contributor::Person:Claude Shannon]]
* '''Required:''' No
* '''Cardinality:''' Multiple

==== Has source ====
* '''Type:''' Page or URL
* '''Purpose:''' Trace claim to origin
* '''Example:''' [[Has source::https://doi.org/10.1000/example]]
* '''Required:''' Yes
* '''Cardinality:''' Multiple (multiple sources encouraged)

==== Has creation date ====
* '''Type:''' Date
* '''Purpose:''' Record when entity was created
* '''Example:''' [[Has creation date::2026-02-14]]
* '''Required:''' Yes
* '''Cardinality:''' Single

==== Has modification date ====
* '''Type:''' Date
* '''Purpose:''' Track last edit timestamp
* '''Example:''' [[Has modification date::2026-02-14]]
* '''Required:''' No
* '''Cardinality:''' Single

==== Has version ====
* '''Type:''' Text
* '''Purpose:''' Track content versioning
* '''Pattern:''' Semantic versioning (X.Y.Z[-label])
* '''Example:''' [[Has version::3.0.0-consolidated]]
* '''Required:''' Yes
* '''Cardinality:''' Single

=== 4. Relational Properties ===

==== Has related ====
* '''Type:''' Page
* '''Purpose:''' Link associated entities
* '''Example:''' [[Has related::Idea:Feedback Loop]]
* '''Required:''' No
* '''Cardinality:''' Multiple (many relationships expected)

==== Has parent ====
* '''Type:''' Page
* '''Purpose:''' Establish hierarchical supertype relationship
* '''Example:''' [[Has parent::Topic:Systems Science]]
* '''Required:''' No
* '''Cardinality:''' Single

==== Has child ====
* '''Type:''' Page
* '''Purpose:''' Inverse of Has parent; establish subtype relationship
* '''Example:''' [[Has child::Topic:Cybernetics]]
* '''Required:''' No
* '''Cardinality:''' Multiple

==== Has part ====
* '''Type:''' Page
* '''Purpose:''' Component relationship (merological)
* '''Example:''' [[Has part::Implementation:PID Controller]]
* '''Required:''' No
* '''Cardinality:''' Multiple

==== Is part of ====
* '''Type:''' Page
* '''Purpose:''' Inverse of Has part; containment relationship
* '''Example:''' [[Is part of::Project:BITwiki]]
* '''Required:''' No
* '''Cardinality:''' Multiple

==== Depends on ====
* '''Type:''' Page
* '''Purpose:''' Dependency relationship (logical or functional)
* '''Example:''' [[Depends on::Idea:Recursion]]
* '''Required:''' No
* '''Cardinality:''' Multiple

==== Validates ====
* '''Type:''' Page
* '''Purpose:''' Evidence relationship; source validates target claim
* '''Example:''' [[Validates::Claim:Emergence is real]]
* '''Required:''' No
* '''Cardinality:''' Multiple

==== Conflicts with ====
* '''Type:''' Page
* '''Purpose:''' Opposition relationship; indicates contradiction or tension
* '''Example:''' [[Conflicts with::Idea:Reductionism]]
* '''Required:''' No
* '''Cardinality:''' Multiple

=== 5. Descriptive Properties ===

==== Has description ====
* '''Type:''' Text
* '''Purpose:''' Brief entity summary
* '''Constraints:''' Concise, informative; max 500 characters recommended
* '''Example:''' [[Has description::Study of complex systems and emergent phenomena]]
* '''Required:''' Yes
* '''Cardinality:''' Single

==== Has definition ====
* '''Type:''' Text
* '''Purpose:''' Formal definition of entity
* '''Example:''' [[Has definition::Emergence is the phenomenon where complex systems exhibit properties not present in individual components]]
* '''Required:''' No
* '''Cardinality:''' Single

==== Has scope ====
* '''Type:''' Text
* '''Purpose:''' Domain boundaries and applicability
* '''Example:''' [[Has scope::Systems science and computational applications]]
* '''Required:''' No
* '''Cardinality:''' Single

==== Has domain ====
* '''Type:''' Text
* '''Purpose:''' Knowledge domain classification
* '''Example:''' [[Has domain::cybernetics]]
* '''Required:''' Yes
* '''Cardinality:''' Multiple

=== 6. Temporal Properties ===

==== Has start date ====
* '''Type:''' Date
* '''Purpose:''' Project/protocol beginning timestamp
* '''Example:''' [[Has start date::1990-01-01]]
* '''Required:''' No
* '''Cardinality:''' Single

==== Has end date ====
* '''Type:''' Date
* '''Purpose:''' Project/protocol completion timestamp
* '''Example:''' [[Has end date::2003-12-31]]
* '''Required:''' No
* '''Cardinality:''' Single

==== Has duration ====
* '''Type:''' Quantity
* '''Purpose:''' Time span measurement
* '''Unit:''' Years, months, days
* '''Example:''' [[Has duration::13 years]]
* '''Required:''' No
* '''Cardinality:''' Single

=== 7. Quantitative Properties ===

==== Has word count ====
* '''Type:''' Number
* '''Purpose:''' Content size metric
* '''Example:''' [[Has word count::1500]]
* '''Required:''' No
* '''Cardinality:''' Single

==== Has source count ====
* '''Type:''' Number
* '''Purpose:''' Citation density metric
* '''Example:''' [[Has source count::10]]
* '''Required:''' No
* '''Cardinality:''' Single

==== Has quality score ====
* '''Type:''' Number
* '''Purpose:''' Editorial assessment on continuous scale
* '''Constraints:''' 0.0 <= value <= 1.0
* '''Example:''' [[Has quality score::0.85]]
* '''Required:''' No
* '''Cardinality:''' Single
* '''Note:''' Use for precise quantitative quality assessment

==== Has quality ====
* '''Type:''' Text
* '''Purpose:''' Editorial assessment category
* '''Values:''' draft, review, polished, exemplary
* '''Example:''' [[Has quality::polished]]
* '''Required:''' No
* '''Cardinality:''' Single
* '''Note:''' Use for human-readable quality levels; maps to quality score ranges

== Property Constraints: Guidelines for Consistency ==

=== Cardinality ===

| Property | Cardinality | Notes |
|----------|-------------|-------|
| Has entity type | Single | One primary type per entity |
| Has epistemic status | Single | One status per claim |
| Has confidence score | Single | One numeric score per claim |
| Has confidence | Single | One qualitative level per claim |
| Has author | Multiple | Multiple contributors allowed |
| Has related | Multiple | Many relationships expected |
| Has source | Multiple | Multiple sources encouraged |
| Has domain | Multiple | Entities may span domains |

=== Value Constraints ===

| Property | Type | Constraints |
|----------|------|-------------|
| Has confidence score | Number | 0.0 <= x <= 1.0 |
| Has confidence | Text | Enum: low, medium, high, very high |
| Has evidence count | Number | Integer >= 0 |
| Has version | Text | Semantic versioning (X.Y.Z[-label]) |
| Has epistemic status | Text | Enum of 5 values |
| Has entity type | Text | Enum of 6+ values (extensible) |
| Has quality score | Number | 0.0 <= x <= 1.0 |
| Has quality | Text | Enum: draft, review, polished, exemplary |

=== Confidence Score Mapping ===

For consistency between numeric and textual confidence representations:

| Has confidence | Has confidence score range |
|----------------|---------------------------|
| low | 0.00 - 0.40 |
| medium | 0.41 - 0.60 |
| high | 0.61 - 0.85 |
| very high | 0.86 - 1.00 |

=== Quality Score Mapping ===

For consistency between numeric and textual quality representations:

| Has quality | Has quality score range |
|-------------|------------------------|
| draft | 0.00 - 0.40 |
| review | 0.41 - 0.60 |
| polished | 0.61 - 0.85 |
| exemplary | 0.86 - 1.00 |

== Query Examples: Patterns of Discovery ==

=== Basic Queries ===

All Verified ideas:
```wiki
{{#ask: [[Has entity type::Idea]] [[Has epistemic status::Verified]]}}
```

High confidence claims (numeric):
```wiki
{{#ask: [[Has confidence score::>0.8]]}}
```

High confidence claims (textual):
```wiki
{{#ask: [[Has confidence::high]] [[Has confidence::very high]]}}
```

Recent modifications:
```wiki
{{#ask: [[Has modification date::>2026-01-01]]}}
```

=== Complex Queries ===

Established ideas with multiple sources:
```wiki
{{#ask: [[Has entity type::Idea]] [[Has epistemic status::Established]] [[Has evidence count::>5]]
|?Has confidence score
|?Has confidence
|?Has evidence count
|sort=Has evidence count
|order=desc
}}
```

Projects by duration:
```wiki
{{#ask: [[Has entity type::Project]] [[Has duration::>5 years]]
|?Has start date
|?Has end date
|?Has duration
}}
```

High quality polished content:
```wiki
{{#ask: [[Has quality::polished]] [[Has quality score::>0.8]]
|?Has quality score
|?Has author
}}
```

=== Aggregation Queries ===

Average confidence by epistemic status:
```wiki
{{#ask: [[Has epistemic status::+]]
|?Has confidence score
|format=template
|template=Average_Confidence
}}
```

Total evidence count by domain:
```wiki
{{#ask: [[Has domain::+]]
|?Has evidence count
|format=template
|template=Sum_Evidence
}}
```

== Property Documentation Standards ==

=== Required Properties ===

Every BITwiki page should include:
# [[Has entity type::Type]] — Core classification
# [[Has epistemic status::Status]] — Validation tier
# [[Has confidence score::Number]] OR [[Has confidence::Level]] — Certainty assessment
# [[Has author::Page]] — Attribution
# [[Has creation date::Date]] — Temporal anchor
# [[Has version::Text]] — Version tracking

=== Recommended Properties ===

Strongly encouraged for comprehensive documentation:
* [[Has source::Page]] — Provenance
* [[Has related::Page]] — Relationship mapping
* [[Has description::Text]] — Human-readable summary
* [[Has evidence count::Number]] — Empirical support
* [[Has domain::Text]] — Domain classification

=== Optional Properties ===

Use when applicable:
* [[Has parent::Page]] — Hierarchical structure
* [[Has part::Page]] — Component relationships
* [[Has start date::Date]] — Temporal bounds
* [[Has word count::Number]] — Content metrics
* [[Has quality score::Number]] OR [[Has quality::Level]] — Editorial status

== Property Evolution Guidelines ==

=== Adding New Properties ===

When the existing vocabulary proves insufficient:

# '''Document the need''': What cannot be expressed with current properties?
# '''Propose the property''': Define type, purpose, constraints
# '''Test in sandbox''': Validate with example queries
# '''Submit for review''': Community consensus before adoption
# '''Update this dictionary''': Add to canonical reference

=== Deprecating Properties ===

When properties fall into disuse:

# '''Mark deprecated''': Add deprecation notice
# '''Suggest alternatives''': Map to replacement properties
# '''Migrate existing''': Update pages using deprecated properties
# '''Archive''': Move to historical reference after transition period

== References ==

# Semantic MediaWiki. (2026). Types. https://www.semantic-mediawiki.org/
# SMW User Manual. (2026). Property declaration. https://www.semantic-mediawiki.org/

# Noy, N.F., & McGuinness, D.L. (2001). Ontology development 101.

| Property | Type | Constraints |

| Has confidence | Text | Enum: low, medium, high, very high |

=== Confidence Score Mapping ===

=== Basic Queries ===

All Verified ideas:
```wiki

```

High confidence claims (numeric):
```wiki
{{#ask: [[Has confidence score::>0.8]]}}
```

High confidence claims (textual):
```wiki
{{#ask: [[Has confidence::high]] [[Has confidence::very high]]}}
```

Recent modifications:
```wiki

```

=== Complex Queries ===

Established ideas with multiple sources:
```wiki
{{#ask: [[Has entity type::Idea]] [[Has epistemic status::Established]] [[Has evidence count::>5]]
|?Has confidence score
|?Has confidence

|sort=Has evidence count
|order=desc
}}
```

```wiki

|?Has duration
}}
```

```wiki

|?Has quality score
|?Has author
}}
```

=== Aggregation Queries ===

Average confidence by epistemic status:
```wiki

|template=Average_Confidence
}}
```

|format=template
|template=Sum_Evidence
}}
```

=== Optional Properties ===

= BITwiki Property Dictionary: Semantic MediaWiki Property Reference =

== Etymology: The Nature of Attribution ==

''Property'' — from Latin ''proprietas'', from ''proprius'', one's own, special, particular. That which is proper to something, that which belongs to it, that which characterizes it. A property is not an arbitrary label but a dimension of being—a way that something shows up in the world.

''Dictionary'' — from Medieval Latin ''dictionarium'', from Latin ''dictio'', speaking, saying, word. A collection of sayings, a gathering of words. This dictionary gathers the words we use to speak about entities—not to fix them but to enable conversation.

== Overview: Properties as Emergent Dimensions ==

This document defines all Semantic MediaWiki (SMW) properties used in BITwiki. Properties enable machine-queryable knowledge by typing relationships between entities. They are not fixed categories but emergent dimensions—they arise from the need to describe, to differentiate, to query.

Properties enable:
* '''Description''': Characterizing entities across dimensions
* '''Differentiation''': Distinguishing entities from one another
* '''Query''': Finding entities that share characteristics
* '''Validation''': Checking consistency and completeness

They evolve with use. New properties emerge; old properties transform; unused properties dissolve.

== Property Categories: Dimensions of Description ==

=== 1. Entity Classification Properties ===

==== Has entity type ====
* '''Type:''' Page
* '''Purpose:''' Classify entity into canonical types
* '''Values:''' Topic, Idea, Implementation, Project, Protocol, Dataset (and emergent types)
* '''Example:''' [[Has entity type::Idea]]
* '''Required:''' Yes
* '''Cardinality:''' Single (one primary type per entity)

==== Has extended type ====
* '''Type:''' Text
* '''Purpose:''' Classify extended entity types beyond core taxonomy
* '''Values:''' Person, Organization, Event, Publication, Tool (and emergent types)
* '''Example:''' [[Has extended type::Person]]
* '''Required:''' No
* '''Cardinality:''' Multiple

=== 2. Epistemic Properties ===

==== Has epistemic status ====
* '''Type:''' Text
* '''Purpose:''' Indicate knowledge validation tier
* '''Values:''' Hypothetical, Emerging, Established, Verified, Axiomatic (tiers may evolve)
* '''Example:''' [[Has epistemic status::Established]]
* '''Required:''' Yes
* '''Cardinality:''' Single (one status per claim)

==== Has confidence score ====
* '''Type:''' Number
* '''Purpose:''' Quantify certainty on continuous scale (0.0-1.0)
* '''Constraints:''' 0.0 <= value <= 1.0
* '''Example:''' [[Has confidence score::0.87]]
* '''Required:''' Yes (numeric representation)
* '''Cardinality:''' Single
* '''Note:''' Use for precise quantitative confidence assessment

==== Has confidence ====
* '''Type:''' Text
* '''Purpose:''' Qualitative certainty assessment
* '''Values:''' low, medium, high, very high (or descriptive phrases)
* '''Example:''' [[Has confidence::high]]
* '''Required:''' Yes (textual representation)
* '''Cardinality:''' Single
* '''Note:''' Use for human-readable confidence levels; maps to confidence score ranges

==== Has evidence count ====
* '''Type:''' Number
* '''Purpose:''' Count supporting sources
* '''Constraints:''' Integer, non-negative
* '''Example:''' [[Has evidence count::12]]
* '''Required:''' No
* '''Cardinality:''' Single

==== Has replication status ====
* '''Type:''' Text
* '''Purpose:''' Indicate replication state of empirical claims
* '''Values:''' Awaiting, Partial, Consistent, Extensive
* '''Example:''' [[Has replication status::Consistent]]
* '''Required:''' No
* '''Cardinality:''' Single

==== Has review type ====
* '''Type:''' Text
* '''Purpose:''' Indicate evidence synthesis type
* '''Values:''' Single study, Multiple studies, Meta-analysis, Systematic review, Textbook
* '''Example:''' [[Has review type::Meta-analysis]]
* '''Required:''' No
* '''Cardinality:''' Single

==== Has last review date ====
* '''Type:''' Date
* '''Purpose:''' Track epistemic review timing
* '''Example:''' [[Has last review date::2026-02-14]]
* '''Required:''' No
* '''Cardinality:''' Single

=== 3. Provenance Properties ===

==== Has author ====
* '''Type:''' Page
* '''Purpose:''' Attribute content to primary creator
* '''Example:''' [[Has author::Person:Norbert Wiener]]
* '''Required:''' Yes
* '''Cardinality:''' Multiple (multiple contributors allowed)

==== Has contributor ====
* '''Type:''' Page
* '''Purpose:''' Acknowledge additional contributors
* '''Example:''' [[Has contributor::Person:Claude Shannon]]
* '''Required:''' No
* '''Cardinality:''' Multiple

==== Has source ====
* '''Type:''' Page or URL
* '''Purpose:''' Trace claim to origin
* '''Example:''' [[Has source::https://doi.org/10.1000/example]]
* '''Required:''' Yes
* '''Cardinality:''' Multiple (multiple sources encouraged)

==== Has creation date ====
* '''Type:''' Date
* '''Purpose:''' Record when entity was created
* '''Example:''' [[Has creation date::2026-02-14]]
* '''Required:''' Yes
* '''Cardinality:''' Single

==== Has modification date ====
* '''Type:''' Date
* '''Purpose:''' Track last edit timestamp
* '''Example:''' [[Has modification date::2026-02-14]]
* '''Required:''' No
* '''Cardinality:''' Single

==== Has version ====
* '''Type:''' Text
* '''Purpose:''' Track content versioning
* '''Pattern:''' Semantic versioning (X.Y.Z[-label])
* '''Example:''' [[Has version::3.0.0-consolidated]]
* '''Required:''' Yes
* '''Cardinality:''' Single

=== 4. Relational Properties ===

==== Has related ====
* '''Type:''' Page
* '''Purpose:''' Link associated entities
* '''Example:''' [[Has related::Idea:Feedback Loop]]
* '''Required:''' No
* '''Cardinality:''' Multiple (many relationships expected)

==== Has parent ====
* '''Type:''' Page
* '''Purpose:''' Establish hierarchical supertype relationship
* '''Example:''' [[Has parent::Topic:Systems Science]]
* '''Required:''' No
* '''Cardinality:''' Single

==== Has child ====
* '''Type:''' Page
* '''Purpose:''' Inverse of Has parent; establish subtype relationship
* '''Example:''' [[Has child::Topic:Cybernetics]]
* '''Required:''' No
* '''Cardinality:''' Multiple

==== Has part ====
* '''Type:''' Page
* '''Purpose:''' Component relationship (merological)
* '''Example:''' [[Has part::Implementation:PID Controller]]
* '''Required:''' No
* '''Cardinality:''' Multiple

==== Is part of ====
* '''Type:''' Page
* '''Purpose:''' Inverse of Has part; containment relationship
* '''Example:''' [[Is part of::Project:BITwiki]]
* '''Required:''' No
* '''Cardinality:''' Multiple

==== Depends on ====
* '''Type:''' Page
* '''Purpose:''' Dependency relationship (logical or functional)
* '''Example:''' [[Depends on::Idea:Recursion]]
* '''Required:''' No
* '''Cardinality:''' Multiple

==== Validates ====
* '''Type:''' Page
* '''Purpose:''' Evidence relationship; source validates target claim
* '''Example:''' [[Validates::Claim:Emergence is real]]
* '''Required:''' No
* '''Cardinality:''' Multiple

==== Conflicts with ====
* '''Type:''' Page
* '''Purpose:''' Opposition relationship; indicates contradiction or tension
* '''Example:''' [[Conflicts with::Idea:Reductionism]]
* '''Required:''' No
* '''Cardinality:''' Multiple

=== 5. Descriptive Properties ===

==== Has description ====
* '''Type:''' Text
* '''Purpose:''' Brief entity summary
* '''Constraints:''' Concise, informative; max 500 characters recommended
* '''Example:''' [[Has description::Study of complex systems and emergent phenomena]]
* '''Required:''' Yes
* '''Cardinality:''' Single

==== Has definition ====
* '''Type:''' Text
* '''Purpose:''' Formal definition of entity
* '''Example:''' [[Has definition::Emergence is the phenomenon where complex systems exhibit properties not present in individual components]]
* '''Required:''' No
* '''Cardinality:''' Single

==== Has scope ====
* '''Type:''' Text
* '''Purpose:''' Domain boundaries and applicability
* '''Example:''' [[Has scope::Systems science and computational applications]]
* '''Required:''' No
* '''Cardinality:''' Single

==== Has domain ====
* '''Type:''' Text
* '''Purpose:''' Knowledge domain classification
* '''Example:''' [[Has domain::cybernetics]]
* '''Required:''' Yes
* '''Cardinality:''' Multiple

=== 6. Temporal Properties ===

==== Has start date ====
* '''Type:''' Date
* '''Purpose:''' Project/protocol beginning timestamp
* '''Example:''' [[Has start date::1990-01-01]]
* '''Required:''' No
* '''Cardinality:''' Single

==== Has end date ====
* '''Type:''' Date
* '''Purpose:''' Project/protocol completion timestamp
* '''Example:''' [[Has end date::2003-12-31]]
* '''Required:''' No
* '''Cardinality:''' Single

==== Has duration ====
* '''Type:''' Quantity
* '''Purpose:''' Time span measurement
* '''Unit:''' Years, months, days
* '''Example:''' [[Has duration::13 years]]
* '''Required:''' No
* '''Cardinality:''' Single

=== 7. Quantitative Properties ===

==== Has word count ====
* '''Type:''' Number
* '''Purpose:''' Content size metric
* '''Example:''' [[Has word count::1500]]
* '''Required:''' No
* '''Cardinality:''' Single

==== Has source count ====
* '''Type:''' Number
* '''Purpose:''' Citation density metric
* '''Example:''' [[Has source count::10]]
* '''Required:''' No
* '''Cardinality:''' Single

==== Has quality score ====
* '''Type:''' Number
* '''Purpose:''' Editorial assessment on continuous scale
* '''Constraints:''' 0.0 <= value <= 1.0
* '''Example:''' [[Has quality score::0.85]]
* '''Required:''' No
* '''Cardinality:''' Single
* '''Note:''' Use for precise quantitative quality assessment

==== Has quality ====
* '''Type:''' Text
* '''Purpose:''' Editorial assessment category
* '''Values:''' draft, review, polished, exemplary
* '''Example:''' [[Has quality::polished]]
* '''Required:''' No
* '''Cardinality:''' Single
* '''Note:''' Use for human-readable quality levels; maps to quality score ranges
